title: Rose curves
hook: r = cos(kθ) draws k petals when k is odd and 2k when k is even.
alt: A single bright line traces outward and back from the center of a faint circle, drawing evenly spaced petals that touch the circle. Changing the number k changes how many petals appear.
author: @tbrazel

presets.label: k = 3, three petals
presets.note: k is odd, so the second half-turn retraces the first and the curve has k petals.

presets.label: k = 2, four petals
presets.note: k is even, so the second half-turn draws new petals and the curve has 2k.
